# Performance Technical Saved Reply

## Performance Impact Notice

**Use case**: Code may affect performance or needs benchmarking.

```markdown
Hi @username,

Thank you for your submission!
Please ensure you have benchmarked any new code for performance and resource usage.

- Benchmark critical paths before/after changes
- Document any regressions or improvements
- Suggest optimizations or alternatives

If you need help running benchmarks or profiling, let us know!
```
